testCountPolicy: Component counts record added cases; final ordinary-suite totals are authoritative for validation. Existing tests were also strengthened.
policy: Fresh static-inclusive bounded runs, at most two simultaneous mutation campaigns with isolated databases. Durations are observations, not controlled performance benchmarks. No score gate, ignored residuals or adjusted score. Do not merge with historical global results or overlapping older ownership profiles.

scopeAudit.limits: Only the scheduled component full-file partition is audited here. Worker/workflow ranges leave documented source outside their scopes; older ownership profiles overlap these results.

backgroundExtent.extent: Full existing component selection, including all nested candidates. No range slicing.
